The group.save error path is effectively unreachable since group attributes aren't modified by adding members via group.add. The mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff; it's a real defect in the new endpoint (misleading success response / dead error branch).

Classic off-by-one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit.
